<?php
class ParkedPendingNextCache35 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ParkedPendingNextReturn35 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function parkedPendingNextChild35() { echo "C|"; yield new ParkedPendingNextCache35(); echo "L|"; return new ParkedPendingNextReturn35(); }
function parkedPendingNextMiddle35() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function parkedPendingNextUpper35() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function parkedPendingNextOuter35() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = parkedPendingNextChild35(); $middle = parkedPendingNextMiddle35(); $upper = parkedPendingNextUpper35(); $outer = parkedPendingNextOuter35();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|"; $injected = new Exception("park35");
echo "T|"; try { $upper->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Throwable $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "N|"; $returned = $middle->next(); echo "RET|", $returned === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
$held = $upper->current(); echo "HELD|", $held instanceof ParkedPendingNextCache35 ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caught, $injected); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($held, $returned); echo "DROPPED|"; echo "E";

<?php
class ParkedPendingNextLate35 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class ParkedPendingNextReplaceCache35 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new RuntimeException("next35"); } }
function parkedPendingNextTake35($chosen) { echo "TAKE|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $chosen; }
function parkedPendingNextTempChild35() { echo "C|"; yield new ParkedPendingNextReplaceCache35(); echo "L|"; return [new ParkedPendingNextLate35()]; }
function parkedPendingNextTempMiddle35() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function parkedPendingNextTempUpper35() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function parkedPendingNextTempOuter35() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = parkedPendingNextTempChild35(); $middle = parkedPendingNextTempMiddle35(); $upper = parkedPendingNextTempUpper35(); $outer = parkedPendingNextTempOuter35();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $upper->current() instanceof ParkedPendingNextReplaceCache35 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); $injected = new Exception("old35");
echo "T|"; try { $upper->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Throwable $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "N|"; try { $returned = parkedPendingNextTake35($middle)->next(); echo "BAD-CALLER|"; } catch (Throwable $replacement) { echo "CALLER|", $replacement instanceof RuntimeException ? 1 : 0, "|", $replacement !== $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $replacement->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caught, $injected, $replacement); echo "E";
